findings.detail: The leaf builds a new feature table from raw files rather than merging existing annotations and statistics.
The primary leaf appends ranked lipid annotations to a feature table but does not merge the statistical results.
The primary leaf applies empirical-Bayes batch correction but does not perform a preceding normalization step.
The leaf corrects batch effects in an existing abundance matrix rather than preprocessing raw mzML data.
The leaf filters an existing post-identification peak table rather than detecting and aligning raw mzML features.
The leaf processes targeted transition-list peak areas rather than raw untargeted lipidomics profiles.
The primary leaf computes fold changes and FDR-controlled univariate tests but does not perform PLS-DA.
